known_baseline_failures: See game-ui-authoring/feature_matrix.json and current repository baseline; do not reclassify unrelated failures as regressions here.
review_notes: GUI Compose and Scene runtime sprites have distinct graphics-pipeline configurations/contracts; a shared low-level owner is allowed if state and lifetime boundaries remain explicit.
Do not create shader or batch layers by primitive name; World2D graph strategy remains a P0 decision between optional runtime stages and a lightweight 2D-only graph.
P0 must freeze and visibly validate sprite-vs-3D occlusion, sprite ordering, transparent overlap, blend/color encoding, bloom and tone-map behavior; pass-call counts alone are insufficient.
CameraComponent must not read View/window state or mutate Transform while producing a view.
Game UI placement is separate from World2D; compose consumes explicit target data and does not create four product-specific renderer copies.
Do not duplicate Render2D Vulkan checks or global session state in new paths.
Do not claim multi-window completion while displayRootTask remains first-root scoped.
A command that cannot be drawn without a camera belongs to WorldDrawList; everything else to ScreenDrawList.
No global 2D draw singleton: shared pipelines belong to the IRender holder, recorders to the target owner; GUIApp creates only the screen half.
Names avoid a Device suffix and F-prefix; the pair is ScreenDraw{List,Pipelines,Recorder} / WorldDraw{List,Pipelines,Recorder}, named by coordinate frame only.
